brief:
Egyptian sports journalist Ahmed Shobair disclosed details about Palestinian striker Wessam Abu Ali's potential move back to Al-Ahly during the upcoming winter transfer window, Shehab Wire reported. The international forward's return to the Egyptian club remains under discussion as the January transfer period approaches.

Abu Ali, who previously played for Al-Ahly, is among several players whose futures could shift during the winter market.

title: Egyptian broadcaster reveals prospects for Abu Ali's Al-Ahly return
